name: Chiyoda (Tokyo, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Chiyoda ward emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised swirl of three curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Chiyoda, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 26 March 1950.

features.role: Chiyoda ward emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised swirl of three curved strokes
